description: We recognized the growing amount of highly progressive and talented younger BMX riders around the world and the lack of 18" products designed specifically for them. The Prodigy Frame isn’t just a scaled-down 20" frame, but a totally new concept built from the ground up using super-light materials and responsive geometry allowing the aspiring PRO to progress faster and ride hard. The Frame uses hydroformed tubing just like our Battleship frame to make the frame incredibly strong and super lightweight. Matched up with an aftermarket Prodigy Fork & Handlebar, the Prodigy line is there to meet the needs of BMX’s best and brightest.
